note: GH.15 container starts (legacy-only, no matrix cell: the host-start rules that bind a start to code are GH.18's, and the process_entry pattern fixtures grade that). Each Dockerfile's stages are read for ENTRYPOINT / CMD (exec and shell form, a backslash continuation joined, a shell form run as ["/bin/sh", "-c", <str>]), WORKDIR, the COPY map and the build-output RUN lines (go build -o, cargo build --bin, dotnet publish -o, ./gradlew installDist), chained through COPY --from=<stage>; one CODE start cell per stage with a start, on the image node, and a separate trigger=healthcheck cell for HEALTHCHECK CMD. A binary start that no build line writes and no COPY brings in (tool/: tini -- mytool serve) mints a CLI_INVOCATION from the Dockerfile MODULE, which resolver:cli pairs with the pyproject's console script; a built binary (server, api, Ad), a launcher start (dotnet, gunicorn) and a health probe (curl) mint none. Before GH.15: no start cell, no CLI_INVOCATION from any Dockerfile.
